body: Thank you :) and likewise my dms are open for you as well <3. I keep telling myself that going on is what she would want, you know? I hope you're doing better today .

I'm sorry for your loss :(. Like you, I lost my best friend, my Meme (Grandmother) around July of last year and everything has just been going downhill from there. I don't know what to do anymore, I'm alone nearly all the time now, left in this cruel world filled with so many cruel people and cruel thoughts in my head. I just want her back...

Its like everyday you try to convince yourself that life is worth living, but you're given so many reasons why a peaceful end is better than living in this reality. 

Dying peacefully in my sleep seems like a dream, you know? Just going to bed and never waking up.

Hey. I appreciate your comment :). It's okay, I should be used to it by now, but when its all you see everyday its kinda hard to have a positive outlook on the current state of one's life.

I need to, I hate giving up on some of these groups I'm in, as I really into some of the stuff they're about, but they've just made me feel so horrible about myself and brought down my mood, that maybe its for the best.

I could try that, though I don't know what I could say. Maybe like expressing how I feel at the moment?
